results.note: The slice faces (x = position 3 +/- 36.5 mm) cut through the outer intake-valve seat pockets, leaving thin adiabatic slivers; T_max and the gas-side 99th percentile are dominated by these slivers and are slice artefacts. boundary_conditions: cycle-mean chamber heat of one cylinder: roof area at the 1-D roof flux, the valve-head share through the seat-insert pockets; convection on all water-jacket walls inside the slice; port gas-side heat input (exhaust ports) not applied; cut faces adiabatic
